# kvindo_kafka (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kvindo_folder" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "kvindo_vpc_subnet" "brokers" {
  name = "brokers-subnet"
}

data "kvindo_vpc_subnet" "controllers" {
  name = "controllers-subnet"
}

resource "kvindo_kafka" "main" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "main"
    folder_id = data.kvindo_folder.default.metadata.id
  }
  spec = {
    kafka_version = "4.3.1"

    # One sizing triplet per ROLE: brokers hold tenant data, controllers hold only the
    # metadata quorum. A role's nodes are interchangeable by design, so sizing is per role.
    broker_vm_offer_id         = "g3-2c4-100"
    broker_volume_offer_id     = "gp3-750"
    broker_volume_size_gib     = 20
    controller_vm_offer_id     = "g3-1c1-100"
    controller_volume_offer_id = "gp3-750"
    controller_volume_size_gib = 10

    # Controllers must be exactly 1 or 3 - the KRaft quorum needs an odd voter count.
    brokers = [
      { name = "broker-0", vpc_subnet_id = data.kvindo_vpc_subnet.brokers.metadata.id },
    ]
    controllers = [
      { name = "controller-0", vpc_subnet_id = data.kvindo_vpc_subnet.controllers.metadata.id },
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Optional:

- `broker_vm_offer_id` (String) Compute offer applied to EVERY broker. One triplet per role rather than per member: a role's nodes are interchangeable by design, so a heterogeneous role cannot be expressed. Omitting it resolves to the role default and the resolved value is written back.
- `broker_volume_offer_id` (String) Disk offer applied to every broker's log volume.
- `broker_volume_size_gib` (Number) Log volume size per broker, in GiB. IMMUTABLE after create: the volume is the node's log directory and nothing grows the filesystem inside the guest, so plan growth rather than assuming a later resize.
- `brokers` (Attributes List) Broker members, one entry each. 1..N and grow-only: Kafka has no broker shrink, so removing an entry is rejected rather than silently ignored. `name` is the real identity - reusing a name across applies keeps that broker and its VM, while renaming is treated as remove-and-add. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--brokers))
- `controller_vm_offer_id` (String) Compute offer applied to EVERY controller. A controller only serves the metadata quorum and holds no tenant data, so it is sized far smaller than a broker. Immutable after create - resizing a voter is a dynamic-quorum operation.
- `controller_volume_offer_id` (String) Disk offer applied to every controller. Immutable after create.
- `controller_volume_size_gib` (Number) Metadata volume size per controller, in GiB. Immutable after create.
- `controllers` (Attributes List) KRaft controller members. EXACTLY 1 or 3 - the metadata quorum needs an odd voter count, and 1 is a supported non-HA tier that can later be grown to 3. Shrinking is rejected, and an existing controller cannot be moved or resized. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--controllers))
- `create_public_ipv4` (Boolean) Add the public TLS listener (port 9096) on a floating IP. The plaintext listener stays bound to the private network, so a public cluster is never reachable without TLS. Immutable: it adds or removes a whole advertised listener.
- `kafka_version` (String) Full patch version, and it must be one the deployed image prefetched - Kafka is installed only from the tarball shipped in that image, so an unprefetched version cannot be installed. IMMUTABLE: there is no rolling upgrade in v1.
- `parameters_set_id` (String)
- `use_fqdn` (Boolean) Advertise DNS names instead of raw IPs, so a node's address can change without every client re-seeding. Immutable: it rewrites every broker's advertised listeners, which connected clients have already cached.
